entries.control_detail: tests/test_12reg_plumbing.py 8/8: 12-wide R36 B1 store (276,242 rows) validates via stock A.validate_store and check_r3_store (failed pre-patch per R36 B1 readjud_summary.json); R35 9-wide store still validates; beam_v3 loads panel-R36 with 10 derived clusters and recovers one planted L=120 key under panel_max and register_cond; hitfn20/panelmax20 raise on panel-R36.
entries.hypothesis: Tooling can be made header/panel-driven so that 12-register panels flow through beam_v3, SWEEPROW validation and the hit predicate without workarounds.
entries.result: Patched beam_v3 (PANEL_PATH env/set_panel, derived clusters), both adjudicate.py copies (row_dtype, header-driven validate_row), panelmax20/hitfn20 (panel=/decoder=, refusal of mismatched bar). R36-B1-ORBIT-12REG now declares its 12-wide sweep_store; validate_ledger 0 errors; tests/ benchmark/ 34 passed; validate.py passed.
entries.coverage: Listed call sites only. Not covered: other consumers of ROW_DTYPE/validate_row(n_registers=9) positional use; a Round 19 bar for 12 registers (use round34 bars_v3 / I2 recalibration).
not_covered: bars for 12-register panels in hitfn20 (refused, not supplied)
FITTED_PANEL_SHA256 pins the R32 rebuild because the R19 panel file is lost
entries.reopens_if: a consumer outside the listed call sites still hard-codes 9 registers, or a 9-register panel other than the R32 rebuild must use the R19 bar.
